phrases.label: hold
phrases.fix: say "contains" for containment, "stores" for persistence, or "at most N" for a cap

phrases.label: carry
phrases.fix: say "has", "includes", or name the field that holds the value

phrases.label: offer
phrases.fix: say "supplies", "accepts", or "presents in the tool schema"

phrases.label: hide
phrases.fix: say "does not display", which states the outcome rather than implying concealment

phrases.label: lets you
phrases.fix: recast with the reader as the subject ("you can") or name the mechanism
